name: Throh (Gi form)
look: a hulking red judoka in a round black gi with white lapels and belt, jagged white trouser hems, big open red hands, a black brow band and flames blazing round its head, shoulders and hips
entry: A Throh that has earned the Master's Gi. Its fighting spirit burns so hot that its gi never catches fire; foes it throws land wreathed in flames.
how: Use a Master's Gi on a Throh (it unlocks the Evolve button). It learns Inferno Toss when it changes.
Master's Gi: crafted from six White Wool, a Gold Ingot, a Black Belt and a Diamond, or found in dojo chests.
